verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical, so the call is a tie. Both use a sensible left-to-right banner order (eyebrow and headline, then CTA, then product), but share the same flaws: 'Every mixed case.' is squeezed into a cramped three-line stack next to the headline, the can is shrunk to a tiny unreadable icon inside its circle, the 'Ends Sunday. Online only.' fine print sits jammed against the circle's edge, the right end is left as dead space, and the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow is very small at this size.
